response.original_title: Vader Episode II: Echoes of the Jedi - a Star Wars Theory Fan Film
response.overview: Eight months after the rise of the Galactic Empire, the galaxy trembles in the wake of the Emperor's new apprentice, DARTH VADER. On the planet Naboo, near the tomb of Padme Amidala, rumors of a powerful Jedi have surfaced. Lord Vader and a squad of 501st Troopers are dispatched to purge the area. But beneath the Dark Lord's armor, the ghost of Anakin Skywalker still stirs....
